notes: An RP of avatars of different ages living in houses with shops to browse is Roleplay & Avatar Sim, and the author confirmed players move into houses that are already there, which the genre file maps directly onto the Life preset and the settlement-claimable housing model. Houses, shops and other buildings players go inside give building-interior, and the claimable model carries interiors too, so the route is P3. I swapped the preset's path-road-vehicle for path-street without a user: asked whether this was a single street or a town you need a car to cross, the author chose a small town with one main street that is easy to play, so the 15- and 30-stud car widths would be laid down for vehicles nobody asked for. District-zoned survives as the split between that shop-lined main street and the houses, and the item categories of baby, pet and food are inventory rather than layout, so they are shop dressing rather than picks.
